specification.experiment: E2b repeated observations and sealed threshold transfer
specification.selection: fixed office0 development and room0 evaluation before new GT or scores; no failed-scene replacement
specification.observation_arm: longer input interval; raw original KF self branches only; no extra predictor or relaxed masks
specification.primary_method_selection: development only: among spacing and relative with support veto, maximize global bad recall under 99% global and eligible normal retention; tie prefer spacing

normalizations.spacing: existing E2 positive front margin / local raw point spacing
normalizations.relative: existing E2 spacing-normalized margin * local spacing / observed point radius

specification.repeat_score: second largest finite per-view front score at same decision revision; >=2 distinct raw events; no union across snapshots
specification.support_veto: a finite reliable plane front score of zero from any source-disjoint view vetoes repeated rejection in that snapshot; unknown/occluded views neither reject nor certify support
specification.decision: strict score > development threshold at actual KF snapshot; lock first crossing; no actual map deletion; cumulative maximum score used only to calibrate the equivalent any-crossing rule
specification.calibration: higher quantile of development normal per-candidate cumulative maximum over all causal re-evaluations; missing kept; no eligible development normal => uncalibrated, no GO
specification.gt_views: even original frame IDs every 20 frames plus actual original KF IDs; GT never features
specification.evaluation_pose: creation snapshot; evaluation-only global Sim3 fitted on mapping trajectory camera centers; GT-anchor sensitivity retains predicted scale
specification.scope: one development scene and one different evaluation scene; diagnostic would_reject only; E3 decision readiness, not map efficacy or statistical independence
specification.evaluation_rule: seal rules and selected development method/thresholds before evaluating room0 labels; every registered evaluation scene retained

specification.evaluation_pose: final revision 188; one Sim(3) fitted on all 180 mapping-input camera centers only; no geometry fitting
specification.gt_pose_diagnostic: replace each anchor rigid pose with GT; retain global-aligned predicted anchor scale; no local GT depth scale fitting
specification.taxonomy_views: even original IDs 0,20,...,340 plus all five original KF IDs
specification.candidate_placement: active candidates use exact persisted PLY world parameters, verified against original TF32 GPU bake; inactive raw candidates use float64 Sim(3) placement; CPU-vs-Ply placement discrepancy is recorded
specification.tolerance_rule: max(abs_m, relative * GT z-depth); pilot operating values fixed before E1 measurements, not tuned performance thresholds
specification.label_rule: front: >=2 reliable GT-view front conflicts with >=1 degree angular separation and zero support; valid: >=1 support and zero front conflicts; all other cases ambiguous; behind-surface alone is never front error
specification.duplicate_rule: valid center near a valid center from an earlier KF with compatible nearest-GT-surfel normal; spatial redundancy proxy, no removal claim
specification.projected_footprint: opacity * 2*pi*sqrt(det(J Sigma J^T + 0.3 I)) at the projected mean; repeated-front ellipsoid subset only; isolated mass proxy without transmittance, separate from actual composited class weights
specification.render_views: all 180 odd original frame IDs; E0 validation 1..39, E0 held-out test 41..119, extension held-out diagnostic 121..359
specification.render_depth: alpha-weighted expected camera z; covered if composited weight > 0.001
specification.render_camera: same compiled upstream rasterizer; E1 evaluation wrapper applies exact fx,fy,cx,cy, including pixel-center convention; older E0 helper assumed centered principal point
specification.split_policy: no held-out RGB or depth used to build candidate labels, fit alignment, choose thresholds, or update map; odd GT used only for final rendering evaluation
specification.scope: single-scene descriptive pilot; center/ellipsoid/footprint are diagnostics, not a strict GT floater oracle; no efficacy, statistical significance, or research-wide GO claim

label_info.gt_use: evaluation only; no score or test threshold tuning
